questions.question: In 2020, what were the total personal health care expenditures for residents of California, in millions of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_state_health_expenditures_by_residence.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1 Personal Health Care', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Region/state').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
headers = df.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
data.columns = headers
col_2020 = [c for c in data.columns if str(c).strip() == '2020'][0]
ca_row = data[data.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
result = int(ca_row[col_2020].values[0])

questions.question: In which year during the decade from 1991 through 2000 did nationwide spending on home health care reach its highest level?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_state_health_expenditures_by_residence.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 6 Home Health', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Region/state', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(y).strip() for y in df.iloc[header_row].tolist()]

us_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0] == 'United States'].iloc[0]
target_years = [str(yr) for yr in range(1991, 2001)]

year_vals = {}
for yr in target_years:
    idx = years.index(yr)
    year_vals[yr] = float(us_row.iloc[idx])

result = max(year_vals, key=year_vals.get)
